title: AI Run Event
description: A single normalized event emitted by a provider or workflow stage during a run, appended to a run's events.jsonl.

schema.description: Identifies the schema and version this document conforms to.

run_id.description: Identifier of the run this event belongs to.

attempt_id.description: Identifier of the attempt within the run this event belongs to.

timestamp.description: When the event occurred, as an RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z').

source.description: Origin of the event, e.g. 'provider:codex' or 'workflow:review'.
